title: 第17章 赠弓第18章 离开州府
slug: 北侯世子反派的我背景逆天
lines: 朱阳楼。
武老正与裴苏交谈的时候，忽然停住。
“怎么了？”
“毒印散了，萧粦，死了。”
“哦？”裴苏眼里闪烁着感兴趣的光，“那赵岚呢？”
武老所留的毒印，不仅印于人体，还弥散毒息，那赵岚与萧粦接触如此之久的时间，自然也沾染印记，行踪被武老掌控。
“在东南方覃地的山野之间，走得不快，应该是以隐匿为主。”
“萧粦已死，龙雀应当就在那赵岚身上，朝廷至宝，也该收回来了。”
裴苏眼里含笑望着远方，仿佛刺破空间瞧见了极远之处，那个青年背着古刀徒步的场景。
武老也面容阴鸷。
“那萧粦当年究竟藏了几滴帝血，也是时候知晓了，若他临死连其养子都不告诉，那我们再找下去也是无果，任由其跟他下地府去吧。”
武老再转头，却发现裴苏低下了头，像是在思考什么。
“少主？”
裴苏才抬头，幽幽望了一窗外的碧草红花。
“过会便出发吧，是时候结束了。”
裴苏径直离开了房间，朝着楼外的院子走去。
朱阳楼外面的院子里，种有不少奇花异草，皆是柳公允差人从万里之外移栽而来。
比如那“蓝田玉荷”，花瓣莹润如美玉，散发着幽微冷香，传闻是由南疆异族培育的异种花卉，在中原颇为少见，价值盎然。
只见玉荷之旁，正半蹲着一个少女人影，眼神惊喜。
“喜欢花吗？”
姜岁柠惊了一下，立马起身，发现裴苏就站在她身后。
“蓝田玉荷的确是奇卉，还有墙角处的金缕梅，其稀有程度与之旗鼓相当，除这两者之外，其他的花卉则是稀松平常。”
姜岁柠顺着裴苏的目光又看到了开着角落的呈淡金色的梅花，眼睛又亮了一下。
“蝶梦谷虽然有诸多奇花异草，但毕竟地方不大，品种不似外面这般繁多。”
她向着裴苏解释一句。
“这个小院虽然是柳伯伯倾心打造，但毕竟只是州府的院子，若是让你见了帝京里的御花园，你怕是要惊得更甚。”
“御花园？”
“占地万千余方，纳天下奇卉七万三千之数，其中不乏世间罕有、早已绝迹的绝种，当今皇后娘娘也喜赏花，每年春和景明都要在御花园举行雅集花会，彼时帝京近半的权贵夫人、世家小姐、青年才俊皆会盛装出席。”
听着裴苏的描绘，姜岁柠纯净的脸蛋上已经流露出神往之色。
那可是天下奇卉尽收的御花园啊！
裴苏看着姜岁柠的模样，微微笑道：“想去吗？”
“想是想，不过开在御花园的花再珍贵再漂亮，却是长在喧闹之地，受天下人赞美观赏，我还是喜欢我在蝶梦谷里养的几株黄丹菊，至少清幽，也不令人感觉遥远······”
姜岁柠说着又已经蹲了下去，逗弄着脚边的蓝荷。
“也不知道灵婆婆每日给它们浇水没有······”
裴苏眉毛微挑，笑意不减。
“起身准备，我们要去都督府与州牧告别了······”
姜岁柠愣了一下，然后轻道：
“抓贼。”
姜岁柠张了张嘴，望着裴苏远去的背影，还是没有发出声音。
“哦对了！”

Zhuyang Tower.
When Wu Lao was talking to Pei Su, he suddenly stopped.
"What's wrong?"
"The poison seal is gone, Xiao Lin is dead."
"Oh?" Pei Su's eyes flashed with interest, "What about Zhao Lan?"
The poisonous mark left by Mr. Wu is not only imprinted on the human body, but also disperses the poisonous breath. Zhao Lan and Xiao Lin have been in contact for such a long time, and naturally they are also stained with the mark, and their whereabouts are controlled by Mr. Wu.
"Between the mountains and fields in the southeastern Qin area, you can't walk very fast, so you should mainly stay hidden."
"Xiao Lin is dead, the dragon bird should be on Zhao Lan, and the imperial treasure should be recovered."
Pei Su looked into the distance with a smile in his eyes, as if he had pierced the space and saw the scene of the young man hiking with an ancient knife on his back in the far distance.
Mr. Wu also had a sinister look on his face.
"It's time to find out how many drops of Emperor's blood Xiao Lin had hidden back then. If he didn't even tell his adopted son before he died, then our search would be fruitless and we could just let him go to the underworld with him."
Mr. Wu turned his head again, only to find that Pei Su lowered his head, as if thinking about something.
"Young Master?"
Pei Sucai raised his head and looked at the green grass and red flowers outside the window.
"Let's set off in a while, it's time to end."
Pei Su left the room and walked towards the yard outside the building.
In the yard outside Zhuyang Tower, there are many exotic flowers and plants, all of which were transplanted by Liu Gongyun from thousands of miles away.
For example, the "Lantian Jade Lotus" has petals as shiny as jade and exudes a faint cold fragrance. It is rumored that it is an exotic flower cultivated by aliens from southern Xinjiang. It is quite rare in the Central Plains and is of great value.
Next to Yuhe, he saw a young girl squatting half-crouched, with surprise in her eyes.
"Do you like flowers?"
Jiang Suining was startled and stood up immediately, finding Pei Su standing behind her.
"The jade lotus in Lantian is indeed a rare flower, and the witch hazel in the corner is equally rare. Apart from these two, other flowers are common."
Jiang Suining followed Pei Su's gaze and saw the light golden plum blossoms in the corner, and her eyes lit up again.
"Although there are many exotic flowers and plants in Diemeng Valley, it is not a big place after all, and the varieties are not as diverse as outside."
She explained to Pei Su.
"Although this small courtyard was built with great care by Uncle Liu, it is only the courtyard of the state capital after all. If you were to see the Imperial Garden in the Imperial Capital, you would be even more shocked."
"Royal Garden?"
"It covers an area of more than 10,000 square meters and houses 73,000 of the world's most exotic flowers, including many rare and extinct species in the world. Today's empress also likes to enjoy flowers. Every spring and Jingming, a flower party is held in the imperial garden. At that time, nearly half of the powerful ladies, ladies from aristocratic families, and young talents in the imperial capital attended in their best attires."
Listening to Pei Su's description, Jiang Suining's pure face already showed a look of fascination.
That is the imperial garden where all the wonderful flowers from all over the world are collected!
Pei Su looked at Jiang Suining, smiled slightly and said, "Want to go?"
"I think about it, but no matter how precious and beautiful the flowers that bloom in the Royal Garden are, they grow in a noisy place and are praised and admired by people all over the world. I still like the few yellow chrysanthemums I raised in Butterfly Dream Valley. At least they are quiet and do not make people feel distant..."
Jiang Suining squatted down again as she spoke, teasing Lan He at her feet.
"I don't know if Granny Ling watered them every day..."
Pei Su raised his eyebrows slightly, his smile not diminishing.
"Get up and get ready, we are going to the Governor's Mansion to say goodbye to the state pastor..."
Jiang Suining was stunned for a moment, and then said softly:
"Where are you going...?"
"Catch the thief."
Jiang Suining opened her mouth and looked at Pei Su's retreating back, but still made no sound.
"Oh right!"
